Five comments

Linda’s Waltz

Composed by Bruce MacGregor.
Available on “The Road to Tyranny ” album.
Original is in the key of F - this transcript is “flute friendly”!
Thanks to Peter Saunders for the melody transcription, chords and accompaniment by me.

↳ Posted by Malcolm Reavell on August 22nd, 2023.

Re: Linda’s

Sorry, much better in F, played on the fiddle. Far too bright and shouty in D

↳ Posted by Simon Haynes on June 28th, 2025.

Linda’s, X:2

F transposition.

↳ Posted by benhockenberry on June 28th, 2025.

Linda’s, X:3

Here’s the waltz in the slightly friendlier key of G, though I also play it in F. If I remember correctly, the chords are based on those on the original recording.
Note that the second part is written out in full because of a one note variation on the repeat (a Bb instead of C) in the seventh full bar.

↳ Posted by DonaldK on June 29th, 2025.
